summary: 23 features and 3 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • preset-tasks: add ponytail preset task plugin (504b8d6)
  • preset-tasks: include skill property in command catalog response (a63f5ec)
  • preset-tasks: combine skill directives with prelude templates (325c843)
  • session-background: add background image upload and selection feature (32375aa)
  • dlc: add enable override and IsEnabled properties to debug state (94ebd28)
  • frontend-config: add ShowSessionListBackgroundImage setting (f4e5662)
  • themes: add soccer-themed seasonal variants (f3ababf)

HagiCode-org/web

  • statusbar: add Microsoft Store availability link (337a31f)
  • session-list: integrate custom background image with SessionList (4f8cdb4)
  • session-background: add settings UI and background layer component (935b9a9)
  • settings: add session background image settings (5da6fa4)
  • dlc: add session-background-images feature gate (4e03465)
  • session-background: add Redux slice for background image state (d1893b0)
  • session-background: add API service for background image management (7ef2094)
  • preset-task: add isPinned property to command DTO (5282e44)
  • loading: add localized turbo engine docs URLs in product splash (4e569d4)
  • i18n: add soccer theme translations and background image setting (61318e4)
  • settings: add background image toggle in session list settings (2631c2a)
  • session-list: add background image layer with user setting (5312573)
  • kanban: add background image support to swimlanes (1ae8251)
  • settings: add background image display setting (6692f54)
  • theme: register soccer themes in slice and config (f906a55)
  • theme: add soccer light and dark themes (a0d0869)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • build: prepare development DLC payload for build and run (7d012cc)

HagiCode-org/web

  • session-background: update background image handling and locales (5de77b1)
  • session-list: update background image toggle settings component (829b32c)
